question.prompt: The distance from the center \(O\) to line \(l\) is 6. The radius \(r\) of circle \(O\) is an integer, and \(l\) and circle \(O\) are disjoint. Find the maximum value of \(r\).

solutions.explanation: For the line and circle to be disjoint, \(d>r\), so \(r<6\). The maximum integer value of \(r\) is 5.
solutions.title: Use the disjointness condition
